description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 
 Compensation: $60–$120 per hour
 Location: Global – Fully Remote
 Employment Type: Independent Contractor
 Work Commitment: Approximately 15 hours per week
 Schedule: Flexible – Choose your preferred working days and hours, including weekends.
 About the Role
 We are looking for experienced Hardware Engineering Experts to contribute to an advanced AI training and evaluation project. This role involves creating, solving, and assessing complex engineering challenges that require strong technical judgment, quantitative reasoning, and reproducible solutions.
 The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience owning and delivering significant engineering projects, such as taking a hardware system from development to production, validating computational models against physical test data, designing robust verification methodologies, or diagnosing and resolving complex hardware failures.
 You should be able to connect first-principles engineering concepts with real-world design constraints and develop solutions that can be independently tested and verified. Practical experience using coding agents and AI-assisted engineering tools is mandatory.
 Requirements 
 Scope of Work and Responsibilities
 Create technically rigorous, self-contained hardware engineering problems based on realistic industrial, product development, or research scenarios.
 Develop detailed reference solutions supported by engineering calculations, simulations, scripts, experimental analysis, or other appropriate technical methods.
 Design and evaluate engineering approaches that address practical hardware challenges, system requirements, and performance constraints.
 Use relevant engineering software and computational tools to analyse problems, validate assumptions, and verify technical results.
 Apply tools such as Python, MATLAB, Simulink, SPICE, Julia, C/C++, test automation platforms, and equivalent engineering applications wherever relevant.
 Assess technical solutions for correctness, reliability, reproducibility, and practical feasibility.
 Identify incorrect assumptions, design limitations, calculation errors, and gaps in engineering validation.
 Leverage coding agents and AI-assisted tools to support technical problem-solving, engineering analysis, and solution development.
 Ensure all submitted problems and solutions meet high standards of technical accuracy and clarity.
 Required Skills and Qualifications
 Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Applied Physics, or a closely related discipline.
 Significant professional or research experience in hardware engineering, product development, systems integration, testing, validation, reliability engineering, or failure analysis.
 Demonstrated ownership of substantial engineering work, such as:
 Developing a hardware product or subsystem that successfully reached production.
 Validating an engineering or computational model against physical testing.
 Designing and implementing a hardware testing or verification system.
 Diagnosing and resolving a complex hardware failure.
 Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals, quantitative analysis, and practical hardware constraints.
 Proficiency with relevant engineering tools, programming languages, simulation platforms, or test automation systems.
 Mandatory hands-on experience using coding agents or AI-assisted development tools.
 Ability to develop structured, technically sound solutions that can be independently reproduced and verified.
 Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and technical documentation skills.
 Selection Process
 Application: Apply for the role and complete the required screening questions.
 AI Interview: Participate in an AI-based interview lasting approximately 30 minutes.
 Hiring Manager Review: The hiring team will evaluate your technical expertise, relevant project experience, and overall suitability.
 Compensation Structure
 Compensation Range: $60–$120 per hour.
 Payment Model: Output-based compensation. Experts are paid for each task that meets the defined project specifications.
 Task Duration: Completion time may vary depending on task complexity, individual expertise, and working methodology.
 Submission Requirements: Minimum submission requirements apply.
 Start Timeline and Availability
 The project follows an accelerated hiring process, with positions typically filled within 48 hours. Candidates should be available to begin immediately.
 Successful applicants will be expected to start their first task within 24–48 hours of completing the onboarding process.
 Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
 Engagement Type: Flexible Contractor Assignment
 Expected Commitment: Approximately 15 hours per week
